Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

AVR objects leave every branch to the linker, even one to the next
instruction (linker relaxation), so this is where the displacements rsasm
works out for itself are checked: against GNU ld, linking what GNU as wrote.
GNU ld is run without --relax, which would delete code rsasm keeps.

=== relative branches in both directions
        .text
back:   nop
        breq    back
        brne    fwd
        brbs    3, back
        brbc    6, fwd
        rjmp    back
        rcall   fwd
        nop
fwd:    ret

=== the far ends of each branch's reach
        .text
start:  breq    far7
        .space  124
far7:   brne    start2
        .space  2
start2: nop
        rjmp    far13
        .space  4092
far13:  rcall   start
        nop

=== data referring to code and to data
        .text
entry:  nop
        rjmp    entry
isr:    reti
        .data
        .byte   0
        .word   pm(isr), gs(entry)
        .word   entry, isr, var
        .long   isr, var
        .byte   lo8(isr), hi8(isr), hlo8(isr), hh8(isr)
        .byte   lo8(var), hi8(var)
        .long   entry - .
var:    .word   0

=== I/O addresses and small constants from symbols
        .text
        .set    PORTB, 0x18
        .set    SREG, 0x3f
        .set    off, 12
        in      r0, SREG
        out     PORTB, r1
        cbi     PORTB, 3
        sbi     PORTB + 1, 7
        sbic    PORTB - 2, 0
        adiw    r24, off
        sbiw    r28, off + 1
        ldd     r0, Y+off
        std     Z+off, r1
        lds     r0, var
        sts     var + 1, r2
        ret
        .data
var:    .word   0

=== a location counter in operands is past the instruction
        .text
        rjmp    .
        rjmp    . + 2
        breq    . - 4
        rcall   . + 0
        nop
        nop

=== alignment and .org between a branch and its target
        .text
        rjmp    1f
        nop
        .balign 8
1:      breq    2f
        .balign 16, 0xff
        .org    0x40
2:      ret

=== a small device with no jmp: rjmp vectors and the 8K wrap-around
        .arch   attiny13
        .text
        rjmp    reset
        rjmp    reset
reset:  sbi     0x17, 0
loop:   sbi     0x18, 0
        cbi     0x18, 0
        sbiw    r24, 1
        brne    loop
        rjmp    reset

=== pm() of an odd address
        .text
        .data
        .byte   1
odd:    .byte   2
        .word   odd
        ldi     r16, lo8(odd)

=== refused: a branch out of reach of another section
        .text
        breq    other
        .section .text.far, "ax", @progbits
        .space  0x200
other:  ret

=== branches and calls between sections, in both directions
        .text
start:  rcall   helper
        breq    helper
        brcs    near
        rjmp    tail
        .section .text.helper, "ax", @progbits
helper: brne    start
near:   rjmp    start
tail:   ret

=== at a base address, with data after the code
        .text
entry:  ldi     r30, lo8(table)
        ldi     r31, hi8(table)
        ldi     r24, pm_lo8(entry)
        ldi     r25, pm_hi8(entry)
        ldi     r26, lo8(pm(isr))
        ldi     r27, hi8(pm(isr))
        rjmp    entry
isr:    reti
        .data
table:  .word   pm(entry), pm(isr), gs(isr)
        .word   table, entry
        .byte   lo8(table), hi8(table), hlo8(table)

=== the same at a high base @ 0x1f00
        .text
entry:  ldi     r30, lo8(table)
        ldi     r31, hi8(table)
        ldi     r24, pm_lo8(entry)
        ldi     r25, pm_hi8(entry)
        ldi     r20, lo8(-(table))
        ldi     r21, hi8(-(table))
        ldi     r22, pm_lo8(-(isr))
        ldi     r23, pm_hi8(-(isr))
        rcall   isr
isr:    reti
        .data
table:  .word   pm(entry), pm(isr)
        .long   table, isr

=== ldi modifiers on sums and differences
        .text
a:      ldi     r16, lo8(b - a)
        ldi     r17, hi8(b + 0x100)
        ldi     r18, lo8(pm(b + 2))
        ldi     r19, lo8(-(b - 2))
        subi    r30, lo8(-(b))
        sbci    r31, hi8(-(b))
        .space  0x300
b:      ret

=== a data word referring to a label at an odd address
        .data
        .byte   1
odd:    .byte   2
        .word   odd
        .long   odd + 1

=== refused: pm() of a label at an odd address
        .data
        .byte   1
odd:    .byte   2
        .word   pm(odd)

=== rcall out of reach wraps around, as GNU ld wraps it for avr2, avr25 and avr4
        .text
        rcall   far
        .space  0x1000
far:    ret
